name: SkySEOManager | Bult Edit SEO Title, Description, Alt text Using AI
author: Sky Plugins

sections.description:
SkySEOManager is a comprehensive SEO management tool designed to make the process of optimizing your website’s SEO more efficient. It allows you to bulk edit meta titles, descriptions, and featured images for all your posts and pages from a single interface. With the new Media Optimizer, you can now use AI to automatically generate optimized titles and alt text for your images.

Key Features

  • Bulk Editing Interface: Edit SEO metadata for multiple posts/pages simultaneously
  • Media Optimizer: A new tab to manage and optimize your media library. Use AI to generate titles and alt text for your images.
  • AI-Powered Content Optimization: Use Gemini AI to generate SEO-optimized titles and descriptions for your content.
  • SEO Plugin Integration: Works with popular SEO plugins including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, and more
  • Import Data: Import SEO data from other plugins and delete plugin data when needed
  • SEO Meta Box: Edit SEO data directly from post edit screen
  • SEO Filtering: Filter posts by SEO status (missing title, too long description, etc.)
  • Social Media Integration: Configure social media metadata for Twitter and Facebook
  • Schema.org Support: Automatically generates JSON-LD structured data
  • Debug Mode: Helps troubleshoot plugin detection issues
  • Manual SEO Plugin Override: Manually set which SEO plugin’s metadata to use

🚀 Upgrade to SkySEOManager Pro

Unlock advanced features with SkySEOManager Pro!

Pro Features Include:
* Bulk Media Optimization – AI-powered optimization for your entire media library
* AI-Powered Media Title & Alt Text Generation – Automatically generate SEO-friendly image metadata
* Advanced Media Filtering – Filter images by missing titles, alt text, or other criteria
* License Management – Easy license activation, deactivation, and validation
* Priority Support – Dedicated support for Pro users
* Regular Updates – Get access to all new Pro features and improvements

👉 Get SkySEOManager Pro: https://siteskyline.com/skyseomanagerpro/

Available in Single Site and Multi-Site licenses

Supported SEO Plugins

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math SEO
  • All In One SEO
  • SEOPress
  • The SEO Framework
  • SmartCrawl
  • Squirrly SEO

Usage

Bulk Editing SEO Data

  1. Navigate to the ‘SkySEOManager’ page in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Select the post type you want to edit from the dropdown
  3. Use filters to find posts with specific SEO issues (optional)
  4. Edit titles, descriptions, and featured images directly in the table
  5. Changes are saved automatically as you work

Media Optimizer

  1. Navigate to the ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Media Optimizer’ page in your WordPress admin menu
  2. View your media library and their current title and alt text.
  3. Use the “AI Optimize” button to generate new title and alt text for an image.

Importing Data from Other SEO Plugins

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Scroll down to the ‘Import/Export SEO Data’ section
  3. Select the SEO plugin you want to import data from
  4. Click ‘Start Import’ and wait for the process to complete
  5. The progress bar will show the import status

Deleting SEO Data

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. To delete SkySEOManager data: Use the ‘Delete SkySEOManager Data’ button
  3. To delete other SEO plugin data: Select the plugin from the dropdown in the ‘Delete Data From Other SEO Plugins’ section and click ‘Delete Plugin Data’

Changing SEO Plugin Integration

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Scroll down to ‘Manual SEO Plugin Override’
  3. Select your desired SEO plugin from the dropdown
  4. Click ‘Set SEO Plugin Manually’
  5. To revert to automatic detection, use the ‘Force Re-detection of SEO Plugins’ button

Enabling Debug Mode

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Check the ‘Enable debug mode’ option
  3. Save changes
  4. Debug information will now be displayed in the settings page
  5. CSS and JS files will use cache busting to ensure fresh versions on each load

SEO Meta Box for Individual Posts

  1. Edit any post or page
  2. Look for the ‘SEO Settings’ meta box in the editor
  3. Enter your custom SEO title and description
  4. Character counters will show the optimal length for each field

Configuring Social Media Settings

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Enter your Twitter username and Facebook page URL
  3. Add your company name and logo URL for rich snippets
  4. Save changes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the skyseomanager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘SkySEOManager’ menu item in the WordPress admin panel to start using the plugin
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with my existing SEO plugin?

Yes! SkySEOManager is designed to detect and work with most popular SEO plugins including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and others. It will read and write to the same meta fields used by your existing SEO plugin.

Will importing data from another SEO plugin delete the original data?

No, importing data only copies the information from the other plugin to SkySEOManager’s format. The original data remains untouched unless you specifically use the delete functionality.

What happens if no SEO plugin is detected?

If no supported SEO plugin is detected, SkySEOManager will use its own meta fields to store SEO data and will output the necessary meta tags in your website’s header.

How do I know if my titles and descriptions are optimized?

The plugin includes visual indicators that show when your titles and descriptions are within the recommended length ranges. Green indicates optimal length, yellow indicates too short, and red indicates too long.

Can I use this plugin on multisite?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.
